SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT udf(a + b), b, udf(SUM(a - b)) FROM testData GROUP BY udf(a + b), b WITH CUBE
READ	SELECT udf(a), udf(b), SUM(b) FROM testData GROUP BY udf(a), b WITH CUBE
READ	SELECT udf(a + b), b, SUM(a - b) FROM testData GROUP BY a + b, b WITH ROLLUP
READ	SELECT udf(a), b, udf(SUM(b)) FROM testData GROUP BY udf(a), b WITH ROLLUP
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW courseSales AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT course, year, SUM(earnings) FROM courseSales GROUP BY ROLLUP(course, year) ORDER BY udf(course), year
READ	SELECT course, year, SUM(earnings) FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year) ORDER BY course, udf(year)
READ	SELECT course, udf(year), SUM(earnings) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, year GROUPING SETS(course, year)
READ	SELECT course, year, udf(SUM(earnings)) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, year GROUPING SETS(course)
READ	SELECT udf(course), year, SUM(earnings) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, year GROUPING SETS(year)
READ	SELECT course, udf(SUM(earnings)) AS sum FROM courseSales
READ	SELECT course, SUM(earnings) AS sum, GROUPING_ID(course, earnings) FROM courseSales
READ	SELECT udf(course), udf(year), GROUPING(course), GROUPING(year), GROUPING_ID(course, year) FROM courseSales
READ	SELECT course, udf(year), GROUPING(course) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, udf(year)
READ	SELECT course, udf(year), GROUPING_ID(course, year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY udf(course), year
READ	SELECT course, year, grouping__id FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year) ORDER BY grouping__id, course, udf(year)
READ	SELECT course, year FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year)
READ	SELECT course, udf(year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY udf(course), year HAVING GROUPING(course) > 0
READ	SELECT course, udf(udf(year)) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, year HAVING GROUPING_ID(course) > 0
READ	SELECT udf(course), year FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year) HAVING grouping__id > 0
READ	SELECT course, year, GROUPING(course), GROUPING(year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year)
READ	SELECT course, year, GROUPING_ID(course, year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year)
READ	SELECT course, udf(year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, udf(year) ORDER BY GROUPING(course)
READ	SELECT course, udf(year) FROM courseSales GROUP BY course, udf(year) ORDER BY GROUPING_ID(course)
READ	SELECT course, year FROM courseSales GROUP BY CUBE(course, year) ORDER BY grouping__id, udf(course), year
READ	SELECT udf(a + b) AS k1, udf(b) AS k2, SUM(a - b) FROM testData GROUP BY CUBE(k1, k2)
READ	SELECT udf(udf(a + b)) AS k, b, SUM(a - b) FROM testData GROUP BY ROLLUP(k, b)
READ	SELECT udf(a + b), udf(udf(b)) AS k, SUM(a - b) FROM testData GROUP BY a + b, k GROUPING SETS(k)
